name: Scratch Pad
description: Writing tool: Window > Scratch Pad (Alt+Shift+Return) keeps notes outside every project, as formatted or plain text, with pictures of the screen (camera button). Notes are sent to any open project, as a new document or added to the end of a text. The scratch pad can also be opened from every program with a desktop shortcut (Options > Keyboard). Folder and format: Options > General.
author: Quillbinder
